name: What defines a tiny home as a primary residence?

mainEntity.name: What defines a tiny home as a primary residence?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tiny home designated as a primary residence means it's your main dwelling, offering all necessary living facilities. Unlike recreational vehicles, these homes are built to codes that allow for permanent occupancy. This typically involves securing proper permits for utilities like water, sewer/septic, and electricity, and ensuring the foundation and construction meet local building and safety standards. The primary residence classification impacts zoning, property taxes, and financing options, requiring compliance with local regulations for permanent structures.
acceptedAnswer.description: A primary residence tiny home is your main dwelling, built to local codes for permanent occupancy with all necessary living facilities.
